title: ValidateExternalKeyResponse

error.title: Error
error.description: Error message when status is `failure`. Null otherwise.

status.title: Status
status.description: `success` — encrypt/decrypt roundtrip succeeded. `failure` — the roundtrip failed or timed out; see `error`.

description:
Result of a validation roundtrip against the customer's KMS.

HTTP 200 for both outcomes — the operation completed; `status` says
whether the key works.
